Tradelatest · feature audit · XAUUSD H4

Divergence Branches

Each feature has a trunk: its registered formula, recomputed independently from OHLC and compared with the feature pipeline on all 3,017 bars. A branch opens beside it when a different definition, the implementation, or the data would change something a decision reads: a zone, flag, regime, sign or threshold class. Audit both and record a pick. A pick changes no code; each adopted branch becomes its own approved change.

59features checked (Trend / EMA, Volatility, Momentum, Volume, Session / time, Sweeps / structure, Displacement / retest, Liquidity, SMC zones, Rejection blocks, Raw OHLCV, CRT state resolver)
16branches open for a decision
12open branches that follow the ATR decision
17branches closed: no decision reading changes
ImplementationThe pipeline does not equal its own registered formula. A bug candidate.
DefinitionThe registered formula differs from a textbook or TradingView definition. A choice.
DataThe input data, not the formula: clock, source, meaning.

Documentation gaps found on the way (no decision needed, fix with the next change to that file):

  • src/features/feature_pipeline.py:1259: comment says volume_spike has no FM id; it is FM-063
  • src/features/smc/_geometry.py:50: docstring says a swing is a 'strict local extreme'; the code at :70 uses equality, so tied highs/lows both count
  • src/features/smc/order_block.py:105 (and fvg/breaker/mitigation distance docstrings): docstrings say distance to the 'nearest' active zone; the finders return the most recent one
  • src/features/smc/levels.py:56: equal-highs/lows tolerance 0.1 ATR and max 8 swings are code literals, not config (CLAUDE.md §6.5)
  • tools/xau_chart/smc_zone_prices.py:32 and tools/xau_chart/README.md: the chart tool keeps its own copy of the rejection-block rule and its README says the rule is 'not in the repo'; FM-124..127 (features/smc/rejection.py) now are. Same rule today, but two copies can drift.

Candle Images workflow

A parallel branch built from the study cards in docs/reference/candle_theory/. Each card rule is put beside the registered pattern on the last month of H4 bars, 2026-04-21 21:00 to 2026-05-21 17:00 UTC (132 bars). The cards give no numbers, so a card rule keeps the registered thresholds and changes only what the card draws or says. "Downtrend" / "uptrend" = the previous close is below / above the close 5 bars earlier (the registered swing lookback). The cards are teaching material: a pick here chooses a definition, not a trade.

The CRT engine (crt_engine_v2 `_ttl_exceeded`) expires on age > max; this resolver uses >=, so it can expire one bar or hour-mark earlier. The > version was written on branch grok/program12-slice1 (commit 63a6a1d, with tests/test_crt_state_resolver_ttl_boundary.py) and was not merged; trunk keeps >=. While no bar changes it is listed as closed; it opens for a pick here once a run shows a state that differs.

Data: data/mt5/XAUUSD_H4.csv, times converted to UTC through its declared clock (mt5_icmarkets_xau), then FeaturePipeline(timeframe="H4"), active config v2_htfcrt_2026_08 (from configs/production/ACTIVE_VERSION). The pipeline's windows are bar counts tuned for M15, so on H4 they span about four times as long. Charts show the 60 bars ending 2025-05-30 05:00 UTC; counts cover all 3,017 bars. Charts are inline SVG generated by script from these numbers, not images. Reviewed by Claude (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-10-14.
